narrative.overview: A dependable, literary self-hosted product surface with quiet maritime color and conventional controls.

rules.name: The Navigation Rule
rules.body: Accent color communicates action or current state.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif is for identity and hierarchy, never controls.

rules.name: The Flat-First Rule
rules.body: Elevation must explain interaction or layering.

dos: Use Harbor Navy for strongest hierarchy and action.
Collapse work areas into one clear mobile reading order.
donts: Do not use decorative gradients or glow.
Do not expose storage internals in interface language.
